Amy,
Thanks for your patience as we gathered all of the relevant information to follow up on our recent conversation regarding
Belarus. We enjoyed connectingwith you and theteamand are happy to tollow up ifthere are additional questions or
concerns. As we noted in our call, facilitating freedom of expression and protecting the safety of our users in Belarus and
elsewhere is extremely important to us, and we appreciate the opportunity to exchange with USAID on our efforts in
Belarus and elsewhere.
Below are some of the resources we discussed on our call:
• Access Now runs a hotline that Belarusian media and human rights defenders can use to report any safety or
content-related issues. They can help improve digital security practices and provide rapid response emergency
assistance if necessary.
• I have attached a booklet on our Meta Support Pro channel, which is designed to help political, governmental, and
nonprofit organizations quickly and efficiently resolve escalations with the assistance of a live agent. For more
information on this support channel, including how to access it and the services provided, please refer to the
• Further information regarding our ad policies related to elections and politics are below.
[access or personal detail omitted]
share and, from there, request support if they are concerned about payments listed.
Once you've had an opportunity to digest this information, we'd be happy to answer any additional questions or set up a
follow-up call.
Thanks,
Molly
Running Ads About Elections and Politics
[opaque block] 1/4

[opaque block] [opaque block]
Our policy requires that any advertiser who wants to create or edit ads referencing political figures and elections must go
through the authorization process, place "Paid for by" disclaimers on ads and have these ads enter the Ad Library. This
includes any person creating, modifying, publishing or pausing electoral or political ads.
To do this, advertisers must send a document to confirm their identity, verify their location and provide more information
about the person or organization responsible for the ad. They should do this by placing the "Paid for" disclaimer on
advertisements about elections or politics. These ads will be publicly available in the Ad Library for seven years.
This requirement applies to anyone who takes action on ads that reference the aforementioned categories such as
starting or pausing ads, adjusting targeting or any other function related to ad management.
Useful collection of resources:
• Getting Started with Ads about Elections or Politics
• Get Authorized to Run Ads about Social Issues, Elections or Politics
• Policy Education Guide: Ads About Social Issues, Elections or Politics
• Availability for Ads about Social Issues, Elections or Politics
• Manage Disclaimers
New "Page Name" Disclaimer Option:
Starting December 14, 2022, advertisers in multiple countries, including Belarus, who cannot meet the email or website
disclaimer requirements can use the "Page Name" option. This option allows advertisers to display an eligible Page name
older than 30 days on their ads about elections or politics.
If you choose to use the "Page Name" option, the name displayed in the disclaimer will be pre-populated with the name of
your Page and cannot be edited.
Accepted currencies for running ads about elections and politics
To ensure optimal advertiser experience, we constantly review the list of currencies that advertisers can use to pay for
ads. Currently to run ads about elections and politics in Belarus, we accept payments in US Dollars, Euro and Polish
Zloty. More information is available here.

Dear Molly, Teddy, and Oskar,
Thank you so much for meeting with us today! I do not have Uliana's email address, so please
exterdourtankstoeraswellWeapreitedebakrouandonteat oull

In terms of next steps, we welcome any information that you can share on:
• How organizations can join Meta Pro, including what types of concerns are most useful to
elevate through that channel for direct support
• How organizations can learn more about the recent ad policy / procedure changes and
trouble-shoot those issues for Belarus
• How individuals and organizations can remove their payment and donation history from
Meta Pay
We understand that there are sensitivities around this information, so please let us know the best
way to continue the conversation and what's appropriate to share with our partners.
Thanks again,
Amy
